verdict.rationale: Bank feeds are documented on the Pro plan: transactions are auto-imported, merged, categorized and 'appear in your bookkeeping automatically.' Wave's own invoice payments are stated to be 'connected to Wave's accounting feature.' Payroll is a first-party Wave service, but no evidence says payroll runs post to the ledger automatically. Nothing shows connectors to external payment processors or payroll providers, and API docs could not be verified. Missing for 10: evidence that payroll activity flows into the ledger, integrations with third-party payments/payroll systems, bank feeds outside the paid Pro tier, and independent corroboration.
